name: Ibiraçu (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and green in the colours of Italy, charged at the centre with the municipal shield bearing a tree and the date 1891.
history: Ibiraçu is a municipality in the state of Espírito Santo, Brazil, settled by Italian immigrants. According to Flags of the World the flag, designed by José Guilherme Pagiola, uses the colours of the Italian flag and was officially recognised in 1991, the municipality's centennial; the tree on the shield is the giant timber (pau grande) from which the town takes its name.

features.role: municipal shield with a tree and the date 1891
